core_problem_solved: To parse potentially malformed, real-world HTML into a clean stream of SAX events or a DOM tree, by correcting for common syntax errors like unclosed tags.
key_features: Tag balancing to fix malformed documents
Implements standard parser interfaces (SAX, DOM) via wrappers
era_and_niche: A classic, error-tolerant HTML parser for Java, often used as a component within larger XML processing frameworks like Apache Xerces that need to handle HTML content.
reason_for_obsolescence: While this is the more correct coordinate for the library (compared to `nekohtml:nekohtml`), the project itself has not seen active development in many years and is **largely considered a legacy library**. The modern, de facto standard for HTML parsing and manipulation in Java is **`org.jsoup:jsoup`**.
